However somebody told me, that you can play another Alastor to let

not get the second Alastor, but he or she will get that equipment. Is

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:


Generally if querying a card it is better if you inlcude the relevant
card text from White Wolf or one of the apps that use the
official .csv file.

Card text:
Alastor
Political Action
Requires a justicar or Inner Circle member.
Choose a ready Camarilla vampire. If this referendum is successful,
search your library for an equipment card and place this card and the
equipment on the chosen vampire. Pay half the cost (round down) of the
equipment. This vampire may enter combat with any vampire controlled
by another Methuselah as a +1 stealth (D) action. This vampire cannot
commit diablerie. A vampire may have only one Alastor.

Place this card AND the equipment. This would seem to mean to me that
you have to place both, which means if you ccannot place one you
cannot place the other.

Place means the equipment is not played, thus Dmitra could in fact
fetch the Ankara Citadel. Also note that as it is placed, not
equipped, you can put a helicopter on the minion (for 1 pool) and it
will come into play untapped.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Blooded Sand wrote:
>> 1. The card Alastor says, that a vampire may have only one Alastor.
>> However somebody told me, that you can play another Alastor to let
>> that vampire get another equipment for half the price. He or she will
>> not get the second Alastor, but he or she will get that equipment. Is
>> that right?

> Place this card AND the equipment. This would seem to mean to me that

> you have to place both, which means if you ccannot place one you
> cannot place the other.

Correct, but not because of the "and", rather by the general rule that you
cannot attempt something you cannot do.

Similarly, Lucian cannot attempt to steal a Hawg if he already has a Sport Bike.

>> 2. Lets say Dmitra Ilyanova (Brujah Justicar) calls an Alastor. Can
>> she search for an Ankara Citadel and use it? Generally: do I have to
>> meet any requirements with Alastor?

> Place means the equipment is not played, thus Dmitra could in fact

> fetch the Ankara Citadel. Also note that as it is placed, not
> equipped, you can put a helicopter on the minion (for 1 pool) and it
> will come into play untapped.

Correct.
